system.description: A Focus for a scrapper who turns punches, kicks, and full-body movement into a fighting style.

abilities.name: Body as a Tool
abilities.description: Your body is also a useful tool, granting an asset to athletics and gymnastics tasks.

abilities.name: No Need for Weapons
abilities.description: You are practiced in unarmed combat, and your unarmed attacks inflict 2 additional damage.

abilities.name: Resilience
abilities.description: You can take one more moderate wound than normal.

abilities.name: Advantage to Disadvantage
abilities.description: Make a hindered flurry against an armed foe; on a hit, deal damage, disarm them, and gain an intimidation asset against them for the encounter.

abilities.name: Fearsome Reputation
abilities.description: Announce yourself to foes who can hear and understand you; successful Intellect attacks make them afraid and ease your tasks against them.

abilities.name: High and Low
abilities.description: When you and an ally hit the same foe with melee attacks in one turn, your attack deals 2 additional damage.

abilities.name: Moving Like Water
abilities.description: Until a ten-minute recovery, you can attempt a hindered block after failing to dodge an attack.

abilities.name: Throw
abilities.description: When an unarmed attack damages a creature your size or smaller, throw it 1d20 feet; it lands prone.

abilities.name: Divert Attacks
abilities.description: Until a ten-minute recovery, automatically deflect, block, or dodge ranged projectile attacks, but your other actions are hindered after such an attack.

abilities.name: Knock Out
abilities.description: A hindered melee attack can knock a level 3 or lower foe unconscious instead of dealing damage. Effort raises the maximum level by 1.

abilities.name: Stunning Attack
abilities.description: Hinder an unarmed attack; on a hit, the foe also loses their next turn.

abilities.name: Lethal Capability
abilities.description: Choose one specific attack type; attacks of that type inflict 5 additional damage. You can choose this ability more than once.

abilities.name: Master of Unarmed Fighting Style
abilities.description: Your unarmed attacks inflict 3 additional damage, and a successful Might block against an unarmed attack reduces its severity by two steps.
